clips.title: The story
paras: Veteran Uzzek is a Horde quest that sends promising young warriors to seek out a seasoned combat instructor. Stationed just south of Far Watch Post between Durotar and the Barrens, Uzzek teaches new recruits that true martial greatness requires disciplined study as well as strength.

In the culture of the Horde, martial strength is unquestioned and revered above all else. Yet brute force alone does not make a champion. Seasoned commanders know that the greatest warriors are also humble students of the craft, willing to hone their instincts through discipline and study. Aspiring fighters ready to advance beyond basic training are directed to seek out those who have survived the crucible of war.

To receive advanced combat guidance, young fighters travel to the arid borderlands between Durotar and the Barrens. Just south of Far Watch Post, the fortified orc garrison watching the eastern frontier, resides Uzzek. A veteran of countless bloody conflicts, Uzzek now dedicates his years to mentoring promising new recruits in the vital arts of combat and tactical survival.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The Horde honors its warriors because their strength is unquestioned. But the truly great warriors are great students as well.

Seek out Uzzek. He is a veteran of many battles and now instructs young warriors in the ways of combat. You will find him south of Far Watch Post, the orc garrison on the border of the Barrens and Durotar to the east.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Hello, young one. Here for some instruction, are you?
